name: abyssal-eye
description: A living Lovecraftian map of your codebase: watch Claude's tentacles write and eye stalks read, and see new bindings form.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: At session start, fetch the published manifest from raw.githubusercontent.com to see whether a newer version exists. Nothing updates without a click.

history.title: Earlier sessions on the map
history.description: Seed the map from earlier sessions of the project (up to 25 transcripts from the last 14 days).

quality.title: Default quality
quality.description: The view's quality for a viewer who has not chosen one with the Q key.

motion.title: Default motion
motion.description: The view's motion for a viewer who has not chosen one with the M key.
